name: Transform
description: Takes one item a round, does one thing to it, hands it on.
prompt:
Take exactly one item from the @input queue this round. Do the work described below on it, then write the result to the @output queue as a single item, keeping any fields you were given that you did not change.

One item per round, even when more are waiting. If @input is empty, say so and stop for this round rather than inventing work.

The work: describe it here.
